metadata.source_to_support_ratio: User-specified visual beats per section; 5 real-footage beats, 14 infographic beats
anchor_rules: Real footage stays visually primary in every footage half
No constant overlays over source footage — subtitles only in bottom margin
support_rules: One infographic asset per narration section, mapped to the script enhancement cues
Every number on screen carries its label: PROYEKSI / asumsi / periode
safe_zones: Top 12% and bottom 18% reserved for titles/subtitles
Charts keep 10% padding; key numbers stay inside centre 80%
variant_rules: 16:9 hero only in this pass; vertical/square derivatives deferred to publish if requested
Crop-sensitive source: keep faces and vehicles inside centre 80%
metadata.required_footage_note: Bagian S0/S7 menyertakan jalanan ramai Vietnam (permintaan user). S3 pabrik elektronik + pelabuhan; S5 biaya hidup; S9 jalanan sore.
metadata.note: Rebuilt from user visual beats and retimed to 633.43s (TTS 631.63s before S9 fix; now 628.73s speech). Duration per beat split proportionally to narration length.
metadata.visual_plan_source: User-provided per-section visual directions (S0-S9) with reference screenshots.
metadata.data_discrepancy_note: IMF DataMapper screenshot shows 2025 selection ID 5.08k vs VN 4.83k, while WB 2025 actual is VN 5.066 vs ID 5.060 and IMF 2026 projection is VN 5.259 vs ID 5.153. Script keeps the 2026 projection with PROYEKSI label; screenshot used only as context in S2 beat 2.
metadata.fx_reference_note: Screenshots show IDR ~18.252-18.268/USD (Nov 2026) and projections to 18.800. Narration keeps Rp18.000 as Katadata assumption (audio already rendered); screenshot used as context for S4 beat 1.
